notes.title: ICT Fair Value Gaps — Core Lesson (TEST)
notes.own: TEST NOTE — fair value gaps form when displacement leaves an imbalance. Key: only FVGs created by a sweep of liquidity matter. Entry on CE (consequent encroachment).
notes.ai:
## Core FVG Mechanics
* **Fair Value Gaps (FVGs)** form when high **displacement** leaves behind an price **imbalance** on the chart.

## The Validation Filter
* **Key Rule**: Only FVGs created immediately following a **sweep of liquidity** matter. If there is no liquidity sweep prior to the displacement, ignore the FVG.

## Entry Execution
* Frame your entry directly on the **consequent encroachment (CE)** (the 50% midpoint of the FVG).
core_ideas: Displacement must leave an imbalance to create a valid FVG.
Filter your trades: only trade FVGs that are backed by a sweep of liquidity.
Use the consequent encroachment (CE) as the precise execution level for entries.
